has_own_site_evidence: Live Google Maps listing has no website field (website: null from scripts/maps_research.py). Guessed domain saintvictorelectric.com does not resolve via DNS. WebSearch for the business name plus 'website', 'contact', 'email', 'Facebook', 'Instagram' found only third-party/aggregator listings (lantern.llc AI-aggregator profile, promptloop directory, BBB category pages, Thumbtack/HomeAdvisor/Mapquest listings for unrelated electricians). No owned domain, no Facebook page, no Instagram profile located anywhere. Conclusion: has_own_site = false.
email_search_note: No public email found. Checked: live Google Business Profile (phone only, no email field, no website), WebSearch for the business name plus 'contact/email', the lantern.llc aggregator profile and its /book and /data pages (no email exposed, messaging only), and no Facebook/Instagram profile exists to check an About section. Phone is the only real public contact channel; outreach registered as pending_manual.

google_maps.note: Confirmed live via scripts/maps_discover.py (niche electricista, location Port St. Lucie, FL) matching by exact name and phone, then re-verified with scripts/maps_research.py using that exact maps_url. Live Maps shows 28 reviews; one third-party aggregator (promptloop/lantern.llc) cites 23, the live Maps number (28) is used as source of truth per instructions.

services.source: Derived from the 3 verbatim Google reviews (A/C electrical hookups for BreezeMax AC & Heating, above-cabinet lighting for Viveca Karabatsos, attic power cable run for Oleg Plakhotnyy) and the business's own Google photos (recessed lighting, under and above cabinet accent lighting, ceiling fan wiring). Nothing invented.
list: Lighting installs and upgrades (recessed, under/above cabinet, ceiling fans)
Electrical hookups for A/C installations (partner work with HVAC installers)
Wiring and panel work, including attic and wall power runs
services.pricing_note: No price list found anywhere public. Site uses the adapted variant: every job is quoted after a quick look, call for a free estimate, nothing invented.

reviews_verbatim.name: BreezeMax AC & Heating
reviews_verbatim.text: Saint Victor Electric has been a valuable partner to our company, providing reliable, high-quality electrical work for our A/C installations. They consistently show up as promised, do excellent work, and offer fair pricing. Highly recommend their team!

reviews_verbatim.name: Viveca Karabatsos
reviews_verbatim.text: John, cannot say enough of the work and professional knowledge you displayed at my home. Your promptness and installation of my above cabinet lights was great! Will have all my electrical work in the future be done by your company.

reviews_verbatim.name: Oleg Plakhotnyy
reviews_verbatim.text: Very good Electrician crew. They came out and ran a power cable up in the attic. Very friendly and professional. Great people. Definitely would recommend this company for any electrical work.

reviews_note: 3 real verbatim Google reviews (with attached review photos), collected via scripts/maps_research.py directly from the live Google Business Profile. All 3 are in English, confirming language = en despite the French surname in the business name (likely a Haitian-American owned business, common in the Port St. Lucie / Treasure Coast area). Owner/operator first name 'John' comes from the Karabatsos review.

gallery.note: Hero + gallery: real photo attached to a Google review, a kitchen with teal LED accent lighting installed above and below the cabinets. Matches Viveca Karabatsos's review about above-cabinet lighting. Most visually striking of the 5 available photos.
Gallery + contact section: kitchen and open dining area with new recessed ceiling lighting, clean and well lit, no clutter.
About section + gallery: kitchen counter with new under-cabinet task lighting and recessed ceiling cans, stainless appliances.
About section + gallery: living room with new recessed ceiling lighting and a wired ceiling fan.

Nav/footer/avatar/favicon logo: the business's own branded logo photo from Google Business (circular badge, 'Saint Victor Electric Inc, Quality First Electrical Contractor, Est. 2022'), used as the site's brand mark instead of a personal headshot.

photo_count_note: This Google Business Profile exposes only 5 total photos (verified via scripts/maps_research.py, which found no additional photo URLs beyond these 5). 4 are real finished-work photos (lighting installs in customer homes, each attached to a named Google review) plus the business's own logo. This meets the pipeline's 5-usable-photo minimum but is thin: the gallery section uses 4 tiles instead of the usual 5-6, and 2 photos are reused between the About section and the gallery (same pattern as output/mava-services-corp, which reused its hero photo as a gallery tile). No stock photos substituted.
hours_note: Captured from the live Google Business Profile via scripts/maps_research.py, but omitted from the site per the adapted-variant rule (no dedicated hours section in the dark-v2 skeleton); phone is the primary CTA.
